RPSC School Lecturer Special New Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Public ervice Commission (RPSC) has released the New Exam Date for the post of School Lecturer (Special). This recruitment was released for 121 posts. Applications for the RPSC School Lecturer Special Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 01 June 2026 to 30 June 2026. The online examination is going to be conducted on 08 December 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their RPSC School Lecturer Special New Exam Date 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 22 May 2026
  • Application Start Date : 01 June 2026
  • Last Date : 30 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 June 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 10 July 2026
  • New Exam Date : 08 December 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • OBC, BC : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
